bk_nav_hint: A session or programme request, at a time you choose
bk_lead: Choose a Hemi-Sync® session or programme and a free time, or leave us your details and we will write back with the next editions. Your request reaches the team; nothing is confirmed until we contact you.
bk_description: Request a Hemi-Sync® session or programme: pick a free time or leave your details, and the team contacts you with the next editions.
bk_err_name: Error: please give your full name (letters, 2–100 characters).
bk_err_for: Error: choose who the session is for.
bk_err_consent: Error: we need your agreement to contact you.
bk_err_slot: Error: the time you chose has just been taken. Choose another.
bk_err_hold: Error: the time is no longer held. Choose again.
bk_signed_in: We recognised you and filled this in from your profile. You can change anything before you send.
bk_sign_in_hint: Have a Psi account? Sign in and we will fill in your details.
bk_details_hint: We hold the time when you send your details. The request goes out only after you confirm it.
bk_consent: I agree to be contacted by Hemi-Sync România about this request.
bk_when: When would you like to be contacted?
bk_ok_text: Your request has reached the team. We will be in touch soon, with the next editions and what suits you.
bk_confirm_text: We are holding {time} on {day} for you for {minutes} minutes. The request is sent only when you confirm.
bk_requested_text: We have held {time} on {day}. We will contact you to confirm it; until then it is a request, not a confirmed booking.
bk_requested_cancel: Cancel code. Keep it: we will not show it again.
bk_requested_cancel_how: To cancel, tell me in the chat that you want to cancel and send the reference and the code.
bk_failed_title: Your request could not be sent
bk_failed_text: We are sorry: we could not pass your request to the team and it was not saved. Please try again in a few minutes, or write to us through the contact page.
bk_pick_mode: How would you like to meet
bk_pick_nothing: Choose a free time from the list above.
bk_pick_taken: That time has just been taken. Choose another; the free ones are refreshed.
bk_pick_empty_week: There are no free times left this week.
bk_pick_unavailable: The online calendar is not open yet. Leave us your details and we will write back with the next editions.
bk_pick_callback: I would rather you contacted me
bk_pick_back: I want to choose a time
bk_chat_intro: Gladly. Choose the day and time that suit you, then fill in your contact details and confirm: only then do we send the request.
bk_chat_confirm_picker: That time is free. Fill in your contact details and confirm: only then do we send the request. If you prefer another time, pick it below or tell me.
bk_chat_none: Hemi-Sync's online calendar has no open times yet. Leave your request here or on the contact page, and we will write back with the next editions.
bk_chat_elsewhere: Session requests are made on the booking page: choose a time there, or leave your details and we will contact you.
bk_chat_refined: I searched for what you told me. Here are the free times. Pick one, or tell me another day or time.
bk_chat_relaxed: I did not find free times exactly like that. Here are the closest; if you like, tell me another day or time.
bk_chat_taken: That time has just been taken. Here are the closest free times.
bk_chat_not_free: That time is not free. Here is what I have, so you can choose.
bk_chat_ambiguous: More than one time fits. Pick one of them.
bk_chat_cancel_ask: To cancel the request, write me its reference and the cancel code, the ones you received when you made the request. I need no other detail.
bk_chat_cancel_cancelled: Done, the request is cancelled and the time is free again. If you like, I can help you choose another time.
bk_chat_cancel_not_found: I cannot find a request with that reference and code. Check them and send them again, or write to us through the contact page and we will take care of it.
bk_chat_cancel_not_cancellable: That request can no longer be cancelled from here (it is already cancelled or has passed). Write to us through the contact page and we will take care of it.
bk_chat_cancel_unavailable: I cannot cancel from here right now. Write to us through the contact page and we will take care of it.
bk_chat_services: You can book here: {services}. Tell me what interests you.
bk_chat_summary_times: I showed you the free times for a session.
bk_chat_summary_confirm: I showed you the chosen time and the confirmation form.
bk_chat_summary_cancel: We talked about cancelling a request.
bk_chat_summary_services: I told you what can be booked here.
bk_mail_intro: A session or contact request has arrived on {site}.
bk_mail_when: When they prefer to be contacted
bk_mail_stored_no: NO: this e-mail is the only copy, contact the person right away
bk_mail_link: Requests are listed, and marked as handled, here
bk_mail_consent: The person agreed to be contacted.
bk_chat_lead: I found {when}. I will ask a few questions, one at a time, so I can send the request.
bk_chat_ask_age: How old are you? If the appointment is for someone else, write their age.
bk_chat_ask_details: What is going on, briefly? Write in your own words what brings you to us.
bk_chat_ask_phone: What phone number can the team call you on?
bk_chat_invalid_name: I did not catch the name. Could you write it again, with letters only (at least two)?
bk_chat_invalid_age: The age must be a number from 0 to 120. How old?
bk_chat_invalid_details: I need a few more words (between 10 and 2000 characters). What is going on?
bk_chat_invalid_phone: That number looks incomplete — could you write it again?
bk_chat_invalid_email: That e-mail address does not look right — could you write it again?
bk_chat_email_typo: The address seems to have a typo. Did you mean ...@{domain}? Please write it again.
bk_chat_nudge: I did not understand. Answer the question below or press “Fill in the form”.
bk_chat_card_lead: I have everything I need. Check the details and confirm:
bk_chat_card_consent: By confirming, you agree that your details are used only for this appointment. The team will call you to confirm.
bk_chat_card_nudge: I have not sent anything yet. Press “Confirm booking” or write “yes”; to change something, press “Edit details”.
bk_chat_booked_next: The team will call you on the number you gave to confirm the appointment.
bk_chat_slot_gone: I am sorry, the time you chose has just been taken. I kept your details: choose another time, written or from the calendar, and you will not need to write them again.
bk_chat_submit_retry: Your details are kept here. If you want to try again, write “yes”.
bk_chat_summary_card: I showed you the summary of the booking, to confirm.
bk_chat_summary_booked: The request was sent to the team.
bk_chat_summary_failed: The request could not be sent.
bk_err_age: Error: the age must be a whole number from 0 to 120.
bk_err_phone: Error: that phone number does not look valid. Use 07xx xxx xxx, +40… or an international number.
bk_err_email: Error: that e-mail address does not look valid.
bk_problem_hint: A few lines, in your own words: what interests you or what brings you to us. They stay with the team and are erased together with your contact details.
bk_err_problem: Error: tell us briefly what you are looking for (10 to 2000 characters).
